title: The subsonic limit of the 3D Zakharov system
summary: We obtain the optimal convergence rates in the subsonic limit of the three-dimensional Zakharov system for initial data belonging to the low-regularity Sobolev space $\HH^s=H^s\times H^{s-1}\times H^{s-1}$. For the Schrödinger component, we prove first-order convergence in $L^2$ for initial data in $\HH^3$, and second-order convergence under the compatibility condition for data in $\HH^4$. For the wave component, we obtain first-order convergence in $L^2$ for data in $\HH^3$ and second-order convergence for data in $\HH^4$.
